items.a1: Yes. EduVanta is currently a production-quality frontend being built phase by phase. Backend integrations (database, auth, storage) will be connected in later phases.
items.q2: Does it support Arabic and Urdu?
items.a2: Yes. Full RTL layout support for Arabic and Urdu is built in. The sidebar, topbar, content areas, and forms all flip correctly in RTL mode.
items.a3: 11 currencies: USD, AED, SAR, PKR, GBP, EUR, QAR, KWD, OMR, BHD, and INR — with locale-aware formatting via the Intl API.
items.q4: Can it connect to Supabase later?
items.a4: Yes. The architecture is designed for Supabase integration. Auth, database, and storage hooks will be added in a future phase.
items.q5: Can schools and colleges both use it?
items.a5: Yes. EduVanta supports school, college, academy, LMS, and university personas — each with a dedicated dashboard variant.
items.q6: Is this replacing EduDash or modernizing it?
items.a6: EduVanta is a ground-up modernization. It takes the comprehensive module coverage of the EduDash template and rebuilds it with a Next.js App Router, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui, and a proper i18n/RTL-first architecture.

testimonials.t1Text: EduVanta transformed how we manage 1,200 students across three campuses. The Arabic RTL support is flawless, and our finance team saved 15+ hours per week on fee collection alone.
testimonials.t2Text: We evaluated five school ERPs and chose EduVanta because it's the only one with genuine multilingual support. The Urdu interface is perfect for our teaching staff.
testimonials.t3Text: The library module alone is worth the subscription. Borrowing tracking, late fee automation, and catalog search — all in one screen. Our librarian was set up in an hour.
testimonials.t4Text: Parent communication used to take our admin team an entire morning. Now automated notifications go out in seconds. Attendance reports, fee reminders, grades — all instant.

faq.subtitle: FAQ
faq.title: Common Questions About EduVanta
faq.desc: Have a question not listed here? Reach our support team at any time — we typically respond within 2 hours.
faq.q1: Does EduVanta support Arabic and Urdu interfaces?
faq.a1: Yes — EduVanta is built with full RTL support for Arabic and Urdu. The entire dashboard, forms, and reports flip direction automatically based on the selected language. All three languages (English, Arabic, Urdu) are supported out of the box.
faq.q2: Can we run multiple school campuses from one account?
faq.a2: Absolutely. The Enterprise plan supports multi-campus school networks with shared configuration, separate student/staff registries, and consolidated financial reporting across all campuses.
faq.q3: How secure is our school data?
faq.a3: EduVanta uses role-based access control, encrypted data storage, and audit trails for all sensitive operations. Student data is never shared across schools, and all communications are encrypted in transit.
faq.q4: What currencies does the Finance module support?
faq.a4: The Finance and Fees modules support multi-currency fee collection and reporting. You can configure your base currency (USD, AED, PKR, SAR, and more) per school. Conversion rates can be set manually or fetched automatically.
faq.q5: How quickly can we get started?
faq.a5: Most schools go live within one week. Our onboarding guide walks you through school setup, staff invitations, student import, and first-day operations. We also offer optional hands-on onboarding support.
